proposal.summary: Certain IBM TXSeries and CICS TX products could transmit sensitive information in query parameters that could be intercepted via man-in-the-middle techniques.
proposal.affected_product: IBM TXSeries for Multiplatforms 8.1, 8.2, 9.1; CICS TX Standard 11.1; CICS TX Advanced 10.1, 11.1
proposal.cwe_quote: could transmit sensitive information in query parameters

AV.quote: could be intercepted using man in the middle techniques

C.quote: could transmit sensitive information in query parameters

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request or review IBM X-Force advisory ID 257105 and vendor patch/mitigation details; confirm whether transport protection (TLS) or application behavior causes credentials or secrets to appear in URLs and recommend removing sensitive data from query parameters or enforcing TLS.
